subject: literacy
concept: Reading words with silent-e (CVCe) patterns, understanding how the silent e changes the vowel sound
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student adds a silent-e tile to a CVC word tile and notices the vowel sound change (e.g. cap -> cape)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches CVC and CVCe word pairs to their different pictures
exercise.abstract: Student reads CVCe words aloud, applying the long-vowel rule

misconception_flags: pronounces the silent e as its own sound

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
